Package hadur2.core.replay

Class Replay

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.replay.Replay
public final class Replay extends Object
Runs a recorded battle back through a fresh core and guard, the same way the robot drives them, and returns the orders for every tick (CORE-2).

A recording is a list of lines: F,width,height,enemies once (a team member's carries more, see facts(java.lang.String)), N,round at each round start, then an I line per tick, each followed by the O line the live robot issued. Other lines are ignored.

The driver mirrors hadur2.Hadur: the F line builds one core and one guard for the battle (the robot keeps them static across rounds), each N line calls newRound on both, and each I line goes through Guard.tick(hadur2.core.model.BotInput), so a fault is covered by the same safe orders as in the robot (RES-1). The guard's recovery hook is the core's recover, as in the robot.

With a ProfileStore, the core loads and folds opponent memory as the robot would; the recorded orders then only match if the store holds the same profile state the live battle started with (CORE-2's "identical profile state"). The adapter's own prepareMemory, saveProfile and end-of-round calls are not replayed.
